purpose: Reusable video page template library for content-specific layout, typography, motion, data truth, asset tasks, and sub-agent handoff.
generationRule: 32 motion families x 5 visual variants = 160 reusable scene templates; variants may change finish, density, camera, color, and pacing, but not the semantic content skeleton.

ttsTimingAgent.dependency: Template timing uses TTS cue boundaries after audio is available.

owns: local or generated image task fulfillment

forbid: LLM free-form animation choice without template id
one repeated layout for all content kinds
template chosen only because the color looks good

scenarioContract.businessScenario: 半自动视频生成配置页：用户以为需要手动挑完所有视觉细节，系统用自动规划器选择证明更稳定。
scenarioContract.useCase: 开场反直觉页，用于解释为什么默认自动规划色系、字幕、动效，而不是把审美压力交给用户。
scenarioContract.pageTitle: 别把审美压力丢给用户
scenarioContract.usageScene: 产品方法论口播的第一屏，先拆掉错误直觉，再交付可验证的自动规划结果。
scenarioContract.videoSubtitle: 该自动的是判断，不是低质量地替用户省一步。
scenarioContract.primaryEvidence: 用户题材、内容类型、页面任务、素材状态共同驱动模板选择。
scenarioContract.plannerRule: Auto planner may select this template when topic type, page job, data/source needs, and asset state match this scenario.

verticalShortFormContract.plannerRule: Only use this vertical contract when the user explicitly asks for vertical, short-form, Douyin/TikTok/Shorts/Reels, or a vertical platform target.

hookArchitecture.zeroToOneSecond: pattern interrupt: 第一眼拆掉错误直觉
hookArchitecture.oneToThreeSeconds: 用户题材、内容类型、页面任务、素材状态共同驱动模板选择。
hookArchitecture.threeToSixSeconds: 开场反直觉页，用于解释为什么默认自动规划色系、字幕、动效，而不是把审美压力交给用户。
hookArchitecture.sixToEightPointFiveSeconds: 该自动的是判断，不是低质量地替用户省一步。
hookArchitecture.payoffLoop: 最后 1.5 秒回到首帧承诺，形成可循环观看的结论。

mobileLayout.composition: 左右论证改为上下冲突：上方大字反问，中段证据翻牌，底部字幕只留一句结论。

safeAreas.topProfile: top 7% reserved for platform/user chrome; no critical copy
safeAreas.rightActionRail: right 12% reserved for like/comment/share rail; no labels or key data
safeAreas.bottomCaption: bottom 16-22% reserved for one-line subtitle; no proof object under captions

mobileLayout.subtitlePolicy: one short line, keyword highlight allowed, no stacked captions over charts/cards/persona

effectPlan.semanticJob: 光束把错误直觉与证据结论分开
effectPlan.verticalPlacement: midground accent outside caption band and right action rail
effectPlan.fallback: deterministic CSS/SVG effect plate with identical timing semantics

captionContract.band: bottom safe band, above platform caption collision zone
rejects: two-line dense subtitles over proof object

assetDensity.recommendedPersonaOrMaterialVariants: one main proof asset plus 2-3 supporting micro-assets when useful

rejects: crop horizontal layout into vertical without redesign
more than three competing text blocks
right-side action rail covers data label
verticalShortFormContract.motionPlan: 反问卡上推，证据卡翻入，结论章在 2.6 秒前盖住误区。

layoutContract.blueprint: 左侧误区区 / 中央反转动作 / 右侧证据结论区；主标题必须先读清楚，再出现证据章。
layoutContract.familyIntent: 左侧大标题先提出错误直觉，右侧证据块随后覆盖或反转。
layoutContract.visualHierarchy: headline -> contradiction chip -> proof seal

horizontalTextStackSafeArea.appliesTo: html-video template scenes with a headline plus support card or body copy
horizontalTextStackSafeArea.laneRule: headline and support/body card must use separate measured lanes; relative margins must not decide their final vertical relationship

rejects: generated bitmap owns final Chinese text

galaceanEffectContract.semanticJob: 光束把错误直觉与证据结论分开
galaceanEffectContract.fallback: deterministic CSS/SVG effect layer with the same semantic timing when @galacean/effects runtime assets are unavailable
galaceanEffectContract.assetPolicy: use project-authored effect JSON or authorized assets only; do not embed third-party demo assets without rights review
galaceanEffectContract.timing: bind to kinetic-editorial-explainer / calm-premium time windows

motionContract.semanticRule: motion must reveal a relationship, state, proof, path, derivation, or payoff tied to the current script beat
motionContract.reducedMotionFallback: show final semantic state with the same layout and readable labels

dataAccuracyContract.rule: claim-evidence; cite source or keep as conceptual reasoning when no measured data is shown

assetTaskContract.imageGenerationPolicy: generate source plates or foreground objects only; final text stays deterministic
assetTaskContract.personalIpPolicy: use presenter only when it carries a semantic action
assetTaskContract.whiteboardPolicy: whiteboard optional only when selected by scene semantics

colorContract.paletteBehavior: 无黑底，使用暖白、矿物灰和低饱和强调色。

externalReferences.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines / Motion
externalReferences.appliesTo: motion communicates status, feedback, instruction, and continuity rather than decoration

externalReferences.name: Material Design Motion
externalReferences.appliesTo: transitions keep a coherent spatial model, stable layout, and accessible motion fallback

externalReferences.name: GSAP CSS motion primitives
externalReferences.appliesTo: animations prefer transform, opacity, color, and sequenceable state changes

externalReferences.name: FT Visual Vocabulary + Observable Plot
externalReferences.appliesTo: data scenes choose chart structures by data relationship before visual styling

externalReferences.name: Manim transform model
externalReferences.appliesTo: formula and reasoning scenes show stepwise object transformations with visible continuity

benchmarkContract.horizontalComparisonRule: template must be judged against comparable product UI, data journalism, mathematical animation, editorial explainer, and IP-diagram layouts before release
craftRules: thumbnail and modal share the same semantic markup; modal may reveal more detail but not a different design
layout uses a named content skeleton, not a color-only variant
main title, proof object, interaction object, animation track, and subtitle safe band occupy separate layers
horizontal and vertical template scenes keep headline and support/body cards in separate measured lanes with at least 56px planned gap, so renderer QC still passes the 40px minimum after font fitting
motion has an observable semantic target: state, relation, ranking, path, proof, risk, source, voice timing, or payoff
small preview must remain readable without overlaps at the default review-page width

agentHandoff.ttsTimingDependency: bind animation step windows to sync-timecode-plan after TTS timings

rejectList: variant differs only by color
layout does not match content kind
motion is decorative
subtitle or main text overlaps visual object
headline overlaps or visually touches supporting body/card in the same left column
internal workflow, renderer, technology stack, or page number visible
一屏只保留一个反差
证据块不能遮挡字幕

mobileLayout.composition: 白板画布占中上屏，笔迹在主体前景、字幕之上方留出安全带。

safeAreas.topProfile: top 7% reserved for platform/user chrome; no critical copy
safeAreas.rightActionRail: right 12% reserved for like/comment/share rail; no labels or key data
safeAreas.bottomCaption: bottom 16-22% reserved for one-line subtitle; no proof object under captions

mobileLayout.subtitlePolicy: one short line, keyword highlight allowed, no stacked captions over charts/cards/persona

effectPlan.semanticJob: 轨迹跟随白板描线路径

effectPlan.fallback: deterministic CSS/SVG effect plate with identical timing semantics

captionContract.band: bottom safe band, above platform caption collision zone
rejects: two-line dense subtitles over proof object

assetDensity.recommendedPersonaOrMaterialVariants: one main proof asset plus 2-3 supporting micro-assets when useful

rejects: crop horizontal layout into vertical without redesign
more than three competing text blocks
right-side action rail covers data label
verticalShortFormContract.motionPlan: 笔尖跟随主线，圈画重点，最后彩色回填。

layoutContract.blueprint: 底图稳定，白板只做前景语义描线；描线层在主体之上、字幕之下。

horizontalTextStackSafeArea.appliesTo: html-video template scenes with a headline plus support card or body copy

rejects: generated bitmap owns final Chinese text

galaceanEffectContract.semanticJob: 轨迹跟随白板描线路径
galaceanEffectContract.fallback: deterministic CSS/SVG effect layer with the same semantic timing when @galacean/effects runtime assets are unavailable

dataAccuracyContract.rule: semantic-overlay; final text stays deterministic and whiteboard strokes cannot own exact copy

mobileLayout.composition: 旧态在上方压暗，新态占中屏，差异点贴近变化区域。

safeAreas.topProfile: top 7% reserved for platform/user chrome; no critical copy
safeAreas.rightActionRail: right 12% reserved for like/comment/share rail; no labels or key data
safeAreas.bottomCaption: bottom 16-22% reserved for one-line subtitle; no proof object under captions

mobileLayout.subtitlePolicy: one short line, keyword highlight allowed, no stacked captions over charts/cards/persona

effectPlan.semanticJob: 光束揭示优化后的新状态
effectPlan.verticalPlacement: midground accent outside caption band and right action rail
effectPlan.fallback: deterministic CSS/SVG effect plate with identical timing semantics

captionContract.band: bottom safe band, above platform caption collision zone
rejects: two-line dense subtitles over proof object

assetDensity.recommendedPersonaOrMaterialVariants: one main proof asset plus 2-3 supporting micro-assets when useful

rejects: crop horizontal layout into vertical without redesign
more than three competing text blocks
right-side action rail covers data label
verticalShortFormContract.motionPlan: 旧态退后，新态推进，差异标签逐个点亮。

layoutContract.blueprint: 旧状态、新状态、变化路径必须同时可见；变化点不能只靠文案说明。
layoutContract.familyIntent: 左侧旧状态被压低，右侧新状态逐步构建。
layoutContract.visualHierarchy: before fragment -> transform arrow -> after proof

horizontalTextStackSafeArea.appliesTo: html-video template scenes with a headline plus support card or body copy
horizontalTextStackSafeArea.laneRule: headline and support/body card must use separate measured lanes; relative margins must not decide their final vertical relationship

rejects: generated bitmap owns final Chinese text

galaceanEffectContract.semanticJob: 光束揭示优化后的新状态
galaceanEffectContract.fallback: deterministic CSS/SVG effect layer with the same semantic timing when @galacean/effects runtime assets are unavailable
galaceanEffectContract.assetPolicy: use project-authored effect JSON or authorized assets only; do not embed third-party demo assets without rights review
galaceanEffectContract.timing: bind to kinetic-editorial-explainer / glass-product time windows

motionContract.semanticRule: motion must reveal a relationship, state, proof, path, derivation, or payoff tied to the current script beat
motionContract.reducedMotionFallback: show final semantic state with the same layout and readable labels

dataAccuracyContract.rule: difference-visible; before and after states must be semantically comparable

assetTaskContract.imageGenerationPolicy: generate source plates or foreground objects only; final text stays deterministic
assetTaskContract.personalIpPolicy: use presenter only when it carries a semantic action
assetTaskContract.whiteboardPolicy: whiteboard optional only when selected by scene semantics

colorContract.paletteBehavior: 浅玻璃面板、冷暖双强调、避免整屏黑。

benchmarkContract.horizontalComparisonRule: template must be judged against comparable product UI, data journalism, mathematical animation, editorial explainer, and IP-diagram layouts before release
craftRules: thumbnail and modal share the same semantic markup; modal may reveal more detail but not a different design
layout uses a named content skeleton, not a color-only variant
main title, proof object, interaction object, animation track, and subtitle safe band occupy separate layers
horizontal and vertical template scenes keep headline and support/body cards in separate measured lanes with at least 56px planned gap, so renderer QC still passes the 40px minimum after font fitting
motion has an observable semantic target: state, relation, ranking, path, proof, risk, source, voice timing, or payoff
small preview must remain readable without overlaps at the default review-page width

agentHandoff.ttsTimingDependency: bind animation step windows to sync-timecode-plan after TTS timings

rejectList: variant differs only by color
layout does not match content kind
motion is decorative
subtitle or main text overlaps visual object
headline overlaps or visually touches supporting body/card in the same left column
internal workflow, renderer, technology stack, or page number visible

safeAreas.rightActionRail: right 12% reserved for like/comment/share rail; no labels or key data
safeAreas.bottomCaption: bottom 16-22% reserved for one-line subtitle; no proof object under captions

mobileLayout.subtitlePolicy: one short line, keyword highlight allowed, no stacked captions over charts/cards/persona

effectPlan.semanticJob: 低密度粒子强化压力感，不遮挡卡片
effectPlan.verticalPlacement: midground accent outside caption band and right action rail
effectPlan.fallback: deterministic CSS/SVG effect plate with identical timing semantics

captionContract.band: bottom safe band, above platform caption collision zone
rejects: two-line dense subtitles over proof object

assetDensity.recommendedPersonaOrMaterialVariants: one main proof asset plus 2-3 supporting micro-assets when useful

rejects: crop horizontal layout into vertical without redesign
more than three competing text blocks
right-side action rail covers data label
verticalShortFormContract.motionPlan: 压力线快速爬升，选择节点放大。

layoutContract.blueprint: 目标、压力、选择、代价必须分层；不把剧情摘要堆成正文墙。
layoutContract.familyIntent: 压力线逐步拉紧，角色/选择/代价依次被点亮。
layoutContract.visualHierarchy: character desire -> pressure line -> choice cost

horizontalTextStackSafeArea.appliesTo: html-video template scenes with a headline plus support card or body copy

rejects: generated bitmap owns final Chinese text

galaceanEffectContract.semanticJob: 低密度粒子强化压力感，不遮挡卡片

motionContract.semanticRule: motion must reveal a relationship, state, proof, path, derivation, or payoff tied to the current script beat
motionContract.reducedMotionFallback: show final semantic state with the same layout and readable labels

dataAccuracyContract.rule: story-structure; conflict and payoff must match script beats

assetTaskContract.imageGenerationPolicy: generate source plates or foreground objects only; final text stays deterministic

rejectList: variant differs only by color
layout does not match content kind

benchmarkContract.horizontalComparisonRule: template must be judged against comparable product UI, data journalism, mathematical animation, editorial explainer, and IP-diagram layouts before release
craftRules: thumbnail and modal share the same semantic markup; modal may reveal more detail but not a different design
layout uses a named content skeleton, not a color-only variant
main title, proof object, interaction object, animation track, and subtitle safe band occupy separate layers
horizontal and vertical template scenes keep headline and support/body cards in separate measured lanes with at least 56px planned gap, so renderer QC still passes the 40px minimum after font fitting
motion has an observable semantic target: state, relation, ranking, path, proof, risk, source, voice timing, or payoff
small preview must remain readable without overlaps at the default review-page width

agentHandoff.ttsTimingDependency: bind animation step windows to sync-timecode-plan after TTS timings

rejectList: variant differs only by color
layout does not match content kind
motion is decorative
subtitle or main text overlaps visual object
headline overlaps or visually touches supporting body/card in the same left column
internal workflow, renderer, technology stack, or page number visible
避免卡通化过度
代价必须与口播一致

mobileLayout.composition: 核心节点占中屏，外围模块沿手机屏幕纵向轨道进入。

safeAreas.topProfile: top 7% reserved for platform/user chrome; no critical copy
safeAreas.rightActionRail: right 12% reserved for like/comment/share rail; no labels or key data
safeAreas.bottomCaption: bottom 16-22% reserved for one-line subtitle; no proof object under captions

mobileLayout.subtitlePolicy: one short line, keyword highlight allowed, no stacked captions over charts/cards/persona

effectPlan.semanticJob: 轨道层强化中心与外围模块关系
effectPlan.verticalPlacement: midground accent outside caption band and right action rail
effectPlan.fallback: deterministic CSS/SVG effect plate with identical timing semantics

captionContract.band: bottom safe band, above platform caption collision zone
rejects: two-line dense subtitles over proof object

assetDensity.recommendedPersonaOrMaterialVariants: one main proof asset plus 2-3 supporting micro-assets when useful

rejects: crop horizontal layout into vertical without redesign
more than three competing text blocks
right-side action rail covers data label
verticalShortFormContract.motionPlan: 节点围绕核心短距离旋转，关系线依次点亮。

layoutContract.blueprint: 核心概念居中，外围模块轨道进入；节点数量少，关系线不干扰字幕。
layoutContract.familyIntent: 核心概念居中，外围概念按轨道进入并建立关系。
layoutContract.visualHierarchy: core concept -> orbit nodes -> relation line

horizontalTextStackSafeArea.appliesTo: html-video template scenes with a headline plus support card or body copy
horizontalTextStackSafeArea.laneRule: headline and support/body card must use separate measured lanes; relative margins must not decide their final vertical relationship

rejects: generated bitmap owns final Chinese text

galaceanEffectContract.semanticJob: 轨道层强化中心与外围模块关系
galaceanEffectContract.fallback: deterministic CSS/SVG effect layer with the same semantic timing when @galacean/effects runtime assets are unavailable
galaceanEffectContract.assetPolicy: use project-authored effect JSON or authorized assets only; do not embed third-party demo assets without rights review
galaceanEffectContract.timing: bind to semantic-timeline-reveal / calm-premium time windows

motionContract.semanticRule: motion must reveal a relationship, state, proof, path, derivation, or payoff tied to the current script beat
motionContract.reducedMotionFallback: show final semantic state with the same layout and readable labels

dataAccuracyContract.rule: concept-map; relation labels must come from script logic

assetTaskContract.imageGenerationPolicy: generate source plates or foreground objects only; final text stays deterministic
assetTaskContract.personalIpPolicy: use presenter only when it carries a semantic action
assetTaskContract.whiteboardPolicy: whiteboard optional only when selected by scene semantics

colorContract.paletteBehavior: 无黑底，使用暖白、矿物灰和低饱和强调色。

safeAreas.topProfile: top 7% reserved for platform/user chrome; no critical copy

captionContract.band: bottom safe band, above platform caption collision zone
rejects: two-line dense subtitles over proof object

rejects: crop horizontal layout into vertical without redesign
more than three competing text blocks

rejects: generated bitmap owns final Chinese text

hookArchitecture.threeToSixSeconds: 样张对比页，候选墙、选中预览、选择理由和淘汰原因同屏。
hookArchitecture.sixToEightPointFiveSeconds: 风格选择不能只看颜色。
hookArchitecture.payoffLoop: 最后 1.5 秒回到首帧承诺，形成可循环观看的结论。

mobileLayout.composition: 候选墙缩成上方条带，选中样张中屏放大，理由贴底。

safeAreas.topProfile: top 7% reserved for platform/user chrome; no critical copy
safeAreas.rightActionRail: right 12% reserved for like/comment/share rail; no labels or key data
safeAreas.bottomCaption: bottom 16-22% reserved for one-line subtitle; no proof object under captions

mobileLayout.subtitlePolicy: one short line, keyword highlight allowed, no stacked captions over charts/cards/persona

effectPlan.semanticJob: 聚光放大被选中的候选样张
effectPlan.verticalPlacement: midground accent outside caption band and right action rail
effectPlan.fallback: deterministic CSS/SVG effect plate with identical timing semantics

captionContract.band: bottom safe band, above platform caption collision zone
rejects: two-line dense subtitles over proof object

assetDensity.recommendedPersonaOrMaterialVariants: one main proof asset plus 2-3 supporting micro-assets when useful

rejects: crop horizontal layout into vertical without redesign
more than three competing text blocks
right-side action rail covers data label
verticalShortFormContract.motionPlan: 候选滑动，选中项放大，理由条推入。

layoutContract.blueprint: 候选网格、选中样张、理由条、淘汰原因分层；候选必须有真实差异。
layoutContract.familyIntent: 候选样张成组出现，选中样张放大，同时保留为什么选它的理由。
layoutContract.visualHierarchy: candidate grid -> selected frame -> rationale strip

horizontalTextStackSafeArea.appliesTo: html-video template scenes with a headline plus support card or body copy
horizontalTextStackSafeArea.laneRule: headline and support/body card must use separate measured lanes; relative margins must not decide their final vertical relationship

rejects: generated bitmap owns final Chinese text

galaceanEffectContract.semanticJob: 聚光放大被选中的候选样张
galaceanEffectContract.fallback: deterministic CSS/SVG effect layer with the same semantic timing when @galacean/effects runtime assets are unavailable
galaceanEffectContract.assetPolicy: use project-authored effect JSON or authorized assets only; do not embed third-party demo assets without rights review
galaceanEffectContract.timing: bind to kinetic-editorial-explainer / bright-clean time windows

motionContract.semanticRule: motion must reveal a relationship, state, proof, path, derivation, or payoff tied to the current script beat
motionContract.reducedMotionFallback: show final semantic state with the same layout and readable labels

dataAccuracyContract.rule: candidate-difference-required; selection reason must not be color-only

assetTaskContract.imageGenerationPolicy: generate source plates or foreground objects only; final text stays deterministic
assetTaskContract.personalIpPolicy: use presenter only when it carries a semantic action
assetTaskContract.whiteboardPolicy: whiteboard optional only when selected by scene semantics

colorContract.paletteBehavior: 亮色但不荧光，适合工具、产品、清单和短节奏说明。

craftRules: thumbnail and modal share the same semantic markup; modal may reveal more detail but not a different design

rejectList: variant differs only by color
layout does not match content kind
motion is decorative
subtitle or main text overlaps visual object

internal workflow, renderer, technology stack, or page number visible
